messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great! Now let's check your internet speed to see if it's excellent. Please use the `run_speed_test` command on your phone to measure your current connection speed. Let me know what result you get (it will show something like "excellent", "good", "fair", "poor", "very poor", or "no connection").

I tried the speed test, but it says "No Connection." That seems strange since my status bar shows excellent 5G signal and data enabled. What can I try next? I'm a bit frustrated because I really need excellent internet speed.

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
